versionChangeAfterRuntime: The release updates version metadata after the approved gameplay candidate.

runtime.recipes: Both source ingredient orders produced each intended identity on Day. Both world models were visible.
runtime.bombrellaBlast: Bombrella started at 600 HP, spent 100 HP repelling one zombie, moved that zombie from x 280 to 398.52, and dealt 150 damage on Extreme. Retested with the corrected 1.5-source-unit radius.
runtime.bombrellaHealing: Full-health Cherry-nut yielded zero charges. Actual healing granted one charge per recipient. Five blasts healing two plants each yielded ten charges.
runtime.bombrellaProtection: A ZombiePea consumed two charges and left the Cherry-nut at 1200 HP. A sampled stretch of ordinary bites consumed four charges with the Cherry-nut still at 1200 HP.
runtime.levitater: A native mine under Levitater ripened and detonated on contact. The replacement had a new ID, Notready state, 300 HP, and 1498 ticks until arming. Levitater recharged with 1498 of 1500 source ticks remaining. Direct API removal at zero cooldown left the tile without a replacement mine.
runtime.restoration: All three runs restored the baseline SHA-256, checked profile hashes and DP-3. All owned processes were absent after testing.

review: Approved after the actual-healing guard and radius correction.
limits: The blast radius has source and review evidence. The runtime fixture observed the direct target without isolating an outer boundary.
The mine fixture observed contact detonation and direct Debug API removal. Native shovel and the managed mine variants were outside the focused gameplay sample.
The first bite fixture included unprotected follow-up bites before observation. The later multi-charge fixture preserved full target health while charges were spent.
The gameplay fixtures used temporary Day boards and existing artwork. Almanac, fertilizer and save/load were outside the test scope.
